title: Prove published Review comparisons in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-413#published-review-comparisons-via-vitest, plan 863 slice 1, revision 5b8e48655f576d1ceb0a2fa71a952b962d67932f

Promise: "A subsequent exact file read has no origin requests and rejects a completion beyond the local sync."

Verdict: Caught (for the "no origin requests" half, on the Done completion file-read path).

Fault (scratch only, restored): dashboard/server/storyReviewHistoricalFileAdmission.ts, admitPublishedCompletion — before requirePublishedCompletion, inserted `await syncedReviewRepository(source, ...)` (fetch of the published ref) plus a best-effort `syncedReviewRepository(source, ..., completion)` (fetch of the named completion), putting an origin fetch on the path reviewedFileDiff uses for every Done file read. Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Maintained assertions that caught it (dashboard/backend-tests/review/story-review-completed.spec.ts):
- :118 `expect(requests.since()).toEqual([])` in "a {trunk, story-branch} completion keeps its comparison and file diffs ... reading files without origin requests" failed in both modes ("expected [ { command: 'fetch', … }, …(3) ] to deeply equal []").
- :238 `expect(requests.since()).toEqual([])` in "an opened Done review refuses a completion beyond its last sync without an origin request" failed with 2 recorded fetch requests.
- Side effect: "a synced Done review reopens offline from its last sync ... reads its file diff" (:210/:222) threw a git fetch error against the removed origin.
Wrong-behavior observation: the recording stub listed fetch commands sent to origin during the file reads; the :222 stack ran reviewRepositoryStorage.ts:190 → gitTargetFetch.ts:63 from the read.

Limit, the "rejects a completion beyond the local sync" half: not shown to go wrong. Under this fault the beyond-sync read still got 409 (:236-237 passed before :238 failed). Whether :236-237 catches a fault that admits a beyond-sync completion is not established.

Runs (focused command `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run test:dashboard:backend -- 'review/story-review-completed\.spec\.ts$' --workers=1`, scratch detached worktree at the revision after npm ci):
- Baseline 1: 9 passed, 1 failed — ":105" story-branch mode hit the default 5000 ms timeout at 5123 ms, load 14; trunk sibling 3003 ms.
- Baseline 2 (rerun, load ~13): 10/10 passed in 11.68 s.
- Faulted: 4 failed, 6 passed, 10.02 s.
- Restored: EXIT-trap restore, clean status, 10/10 passed in 17.21 s (load ~11.5). Scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: none for the origin-request half. Optional separate probe for the beyond-sync refusal (e.g. skip the completion-ancestry check in publishedStoryReview's completion lookup).

Separate observation: baseline 1 shows the story-branch mode of :105 near the 5 s default under load (5123 ms at load 14).

Cost: test runtime about 67 s (28.47 + 11.68 + 10.02 + 17.21 s); human effort unavailable; agent effort about 14 tool calls. Invocation-to-report elapsed 151821 ms.

Wrap-up disposition: checked 5b8e48655; Caught; no follow-up.
